title: Phosphorylation inhibits intramolecular interactions, DNA-binding and protein interactions of Claspin through disordered/ structured conformation transition
authors: Zhiying You; Hao-Wen Hsiao; Chi-Chun Yang; Hidemasa Goto; Hisao Masai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Claspin蛋白的磷酸化调控其构象转变及DNA结合与蛋白互作，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故评分为5。
abstract: Claspin, known to be highly disordered, plays important roles in replication fork progression, initiation and cellular responses to replication stress. However, regulation of its structure and molecular interactions is not completely understood. We show here, through Proximity-Ligation-Assays, the evidence for intramolecular interaction between the N- and C-terminal segments of Claspin, which depends on the Acidic-Patch [AP] segment near its C-terminus. Interaction of Claspin with DNA and replication factors is highly stimulated in ΔAP mutant and by prior dephosphorylation. The wild-type Claspin inhibits the helicase activity of MCM in an AP-dependent manner. ΔAP and dephosphorylated Claspin exhibit resistance to trypsin digestion compared to wild-type, suggesting the presence of structural domains in the formers. We propose that Claspin is converted from disordered (closed) to structured (open) conformation at initiation, which stimulates its DNA binding and interaction with replication factors and counteracts its helicase inhibitory activity to trigger initiation of DNA replication.
abstract_zh: Claspin，已知高度无序，在复制叉进程、起始及细胞对复制应激的反应中发挥重要作用。然而，其结构和分子相互作用的调控尚未完全理解。我们在此通过邻近连接分析（Proximity-Ligation-Assays）展示了Claspin N端和C端片段之间分子内相互作用的证据，该相互作用依赖于其C端附近的酸性斑块（Acidic-Patch [AP]）片段。Claspin与DNA及复制因子的相互作用在ΔAP突变体和预先去磷酸化条件下被高度刺激。野生型Claspin以AP依赖性方式抑制MCM的解旋酶活性。与野生型相比，ΔAP和去磷酸化的Claspin对胰蛋白酶消化表现出抗性，表明前者存在结构域。我们提出，Claspin在起始时从无序（闭合）构象转变为结构化（开放）构象，这刺激了其DNA结合及与复制因子的相互作用，并抵消其解旋酶抑制活性，从而触发DNA复制的起始。
